transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I guess what brought me in today is that... some nights after I get off work at the store, or maybe after a tense dinner, I'll start eating and it just feels like the decision-making part of my brain shuts off completely. 

It's kind of hard to explain, but it's like I can actually see myself reaching for more food, but I just can't make myself stop. That's really the main reason I decided to come in.
Do you usually feel guilty after one of these eating episodes?

Yeah, I do. Um, usually right after I finally stop, it just hits me. I look at what I just ate and... yeah, I feel really guilty about it. It's just a lot of frustration, mostly, wondering why I couldn't just stop myself.
Do you ever try to make up for these eating episodes by doing something to compensate, like exercising or vomiting?

Yeah, I do. For the last few months, it's been happening most weeks. I'll have one of those nights where the eating just gets totally out of control, and then... well, I try to undo it. Sometimes I make myself throw up, or I might take laxatives. Other times I'll just skip meals the next day, or force myself to go on a really long walk to try and burn it off.
How often do these episodes of eating out of control happen in a typical week?

Well, like I was just saying a minute ago, it's been happening most weeks for the last few months. In a typical week, I'd say it's usually just one night, maybe two, where I have one of those out-of-control eating episodes and then end up trying to make up for it.
How often do you make yourself throw up after one of these eating episodes?

Like I mentioned, the bad eating nights happen once or twice a week, so... the throwing up happens about that often. Usually, I wait until after everyone goes to bed. I'll go into the bathroom and make myself throw up, or sometimes take laxatives, just telling myself it’s to undo the damage from what I just ate. It makes sense in my head at the time, but... honestly, afterward, I always feel really embarrassed, and my body gets all shaky.
How often do you take laxatives after one of these eating episodes?

It's pretty much like I just said. Out of those one or two bad nights a week, I'll either make myself throw up or I'll use the laxatives. So for the laxatives specifically... maybe once a week, or every other week? 

I just wait until everyone goes to bed, head into the bathroom, and take them. I keep telling myself it’s just to undo the damage from all the food I just ate. But whether it's throwing up or taking those pills... I always end up feeling really embarrassed and physically shaky when it's over.
Do you ever have nights where you eat out of control like that, but you don't try to make up for it by vomiting, taking laxatives, or anything else?

Well, no, not really. I always try to do something to make up for it. If I don't throw up or take the pills, I'll... I'll usually just skip breakfast and lunch the next day. Or sometimes I'll make myself walk for a really long time before I have to clock in for work. 

I don't do it because I actually enjoy the walk or anything, it's just... I feel like I have to do it to cancel out what I did the night before.
